meaning: Reconciles a real merge conflict between this batch's TASK-20260912-2100f6 fix (archived under TASK-20260912-8178a2, BATCH-bb548b) and a concurrent, independently-authored fix for the same TASK-20260908-30ce59 REVISE findings that reached main first (TASK-20260912-f821b2 / TASK-20260912-688e64 / DEC-20260912-34c82d, BATCH-53f590), discovered when PR #1126 left draft and GitHub reported mergeable_state=dirty. Both sessions fixed C6, C9, C11, C12 in the same three files (arithmetic.py, rho.py, driver.py) without visibility into each other's work; this batch's fix additionally closed C8, which the concurrent fix explicitly left open. git's line-based three-way merge flagged three conflicting hunks (all in arithmetic.py/rho.py/driver.py) but also silently concatenated two non-conflicting, same-purpose additions into a single module-scope name collision it could not detect: both branches defined a function named scalar_multiply_planted, which would have left this batch's point_add_planted/point_double_planted-based definition shadowed as dead, unreachable code with no textual conflict raised. Each conflicting hunk and the latent duplicate were resolved on their technical merits (see TASK-20260912-c08c1b.yaml's completion_gate for the per-hunk reasoning): main's arithmetic.py Y3/Z3 fix was kept because it correctly threads the file's planted_sink parameter that this batch's own fix (written before that parameter existed on this batch's branch) did not; main's single scalar_multiply_planted was kept over this batch's redundant point_add_planted/point_double_planted/scalar_multiply_planted composition, which was deleted entirely rather than left as unreachable code; main's driver.py check_cgroup_admission design (job_kind, default-compatible, graceful refusal) was kept over this batch's (job_type, required, raises) design, since neither has any live call site in either branch and main's is already the officially-merged form; rho.py's conflict was a docstring-only addition with no functional difference. This batch's own C8 documentation fix (scalar_multiply's normalization-ownership paragraph), which the concurrent fix explicitly did not attempt, survives unchanged in the merged result. All ten path_sha256 values above were independently recomputed via sha256sum against the exact bytes on disk at the merge commit ac956b5ec61957bdc824877ac2594f7d7ee6b9ae (parents: this batch's prior tip 35030a4caef5a271203044714d3debabbfcd819d and origin/main's 2cdca0019219952849ca7c56d13395ea5532a412); the seven files main never touched hash-match TASK-20260912-8178a2's snapshot exactly, confirming they carried through the merge unchanged. This snapshot supersedes only TASK-20260912-8178a2's path_sha256 bindings for arithmetic.py/rho.py/driver.py, which are now stale (that snapshot remains an accurate historical record of what TASK-20260912-2100f6 produced at the time, on a branch that had not yet seen the concurrent fix); it does not alter or invalidate any record from either source lineage. Independent_checker.py and count_predictor.py remain NOT independently authored from arithmetic.py (disclosed, unchanged, still an outstanding admission requirement, per both prior snapshots). All host/boot/cgroup/image/measurement fields in admission-template.json remain null with an explicit blocking reason, unchanged. This archive authorizes none of the declared 40 scientific jobs; scientific_execution_authorized remains false per DEC-20260907-1ccb1a. A future scientific-execution task still requires: a fresh independent implementation review confirming all five fixes on this merged, reconciled source (neither TASK-20260908-30ce59 nor any later review has examined this exact reconciled byte-content), realized host/cgroup/certificate admission, an exact locked plan, and its own execution authorization.
